mapper.insert: INSERT INTO abnormal_pass_record (visitor_name, visitor_phone, visitor_id_card, gate_id, reason, type, operator_id, handled) VALUES (#{visitorName}, #{visitorPhone}, #{visitorIdCard}, #{gateId}, #{reason}, #{type}, #{operatorId}, #{handled})
mapper.update: UPDATE abnormal_pass_record SET handled = 1, handle_remark = #{handleRemark} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM abnormal_pass_record WHERE created_at BETWEEN #{todayStart} AND #{todayEnd}
